name: Unbound3D Lynx 350 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; --- 1. Initial Setup ---
SET_GCODE_OFFSET Z=0 
G90 ; Absolute positioning
M83 ; Extruder relative mode

; --- 2. Pre-heat nozzle (softens plastic) and Heat Bed Fully ---
M104 S150 
M117 Heating Bed...
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]

; --- 3. True Home (Done hot for Cartographer accuracy) ---
M117 Homing Axes...
G28

; --- 4. Tram the Bed (Using Z_TILT for your 3-motor setup) ---
M117 Adjusting Z-Tilt...
Z_TILT_ADJUST

; --- 5. Re-home Z (Crucial: The gantry moved during tramming) ---
G28 Z

; --- 6. Bed Mesh Calibration (The fast Cartographer sweep) ---
M117 Scanning Bed...
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ADAPTIVE=1 

SKEW_PROFILE LOAD=lynx_350

; --- 7. Move to the new purge start position (X10 Y10) ---
G1 X10 Y10 Z5 F6000

; --- 8. Final Extruder Heat (With +/- 5 degree buffer) ---
M117 Heating Extruder...
SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE HEATER=extruder TARGET=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
TEMPERATURE_WAIT SENSOR=extruder MINIMUM={nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0] - 5} MAXIMUM={nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0] + 5}

M117 Heat Soaking (60s)...
G4 P60000 ; Dwell for 60 seconds

; --- 9. Purge Line ---
M117 Purging...
G1 Z0.23 F240      ; Drop down to first layer height
G92 E0             ; Reset extruder distance
G1 X120 E15 F1500  ; Draw the first line from X10 out to X110
G1 Y10.4 F5000     ; Move slightly over to Y10.4
G1 X10 E15 F1200   ; Draw the second line back to X10
G92 E0             ; Reset extruder again
G1 Z2.0 F3000      ; Lift nozzle to clear the purge puddle

; --- 10. Ready to Print ---
M117 Printing!
machine_end_gcode:
; --- 1. Safe Retract ---
M83 ; Relative extrusion
G1 E-3 F300 ; Retract to relieve pressure in the Orbiter

; --- 2. Turn off Heaters and Fans ---
M104 S0 ; Turn off extruder
M140 S0 ; Turn off bed
M107 ; Turn off part cooling fan

; --- 3. Move Nozzle Away ---
G91 ; Relative positioning
G1 Z5 F3000 ; Lift Z up by 5mm to clear the print
G90 ; Absolute positioning

; --- 4. Present the Print ---
G1 X340 Y340 F6000 ; Move toolhead to the back corner

; --- 5. Final Cleanup ---
BED_MESH_CLEAR
M84 X Y E ; Disable steppers
M117 Print Complete
